rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese verb for a court sentencing someone to punishment.

example.english: The judge will sentence him only after hearing both sides.
example.traditional: 法官聽完雙方陳詞之後，先至判刑。
example.jyutping: faat3 gun1 teng1 jyun4 soeng1 fong1 can4 ci4 zi1 hau6 sin1 zi3 pun3 jing4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a grammatically complete sentence.

example.english: This sentence has a subject and a predicate.
example.jyutping: ni1 geoi3 zi2 jau5 zyu2 jyu5 tung4 wai6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this for the punishment imposed by a criminal court, rather than the length of time served.

example.english: The court imposed a sentence on him that included a five-thousand-dollar fine.
example.traditional: 法庭判處佢刑罰，包括五千蚊罰款。
example.jyutping: faat3 ting4 pun3 cyu2 keoi5 jing4 fat6 baau1 kut3 ng5 cin1 man1 fat6 fun2

rows.note: Use this when the sentence means the length of a prison term or other custodial term.

example.english: They still have six months left on their sentence before they are released.
example.traditional: 佢仲有半年刑期先至放監。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zung6 jau5 bun3 nin4 jing4 kei4 sin1 zi3 fong3 gaam1

rows.note: Use this formal legal noun for the court's written judgment or sentencing order.

example.english: The judge read out the sentence and announced that the defendant would be imprisoned for three years.
example.traditional: 法官宣讀判詞，宣布被告入獄三年。
example.jyutping: faat3 gun1 syun1 duk6 pun3 ci4 syun1 bou3 bei6 gou3 jap6 juk6 saam1 nin4
